body.name: empirical and fitted-center Wald intervals
body.construction: \(I_{\mathrm{emp}}=[\widehat\theta_N\pm z_\alpha\sqrt{\widehat V/(NT_N)}]\) and \(I_{\mathrm{fit}}=[\widetilde\theta_N\pm z_\alpha\sqrt{\widehat Q/(NT_N)}]\), where \(\widehat V\) and \(\widehat Q\) plug \((\widehat p,\widehat\gamma_N)\) into \(V\) and \(Q\).
